immune.usageZh: 形容词，意为“免疫的；不受影响的”。常见搭配有 immune system（免疫系统）、be immune to（对……免疫/不受……影响）。既可用于医学语境，也可引申为“不受批评、压力等影响”。

examples.sentence: My little brother has a strong immune system, so he seldom gets sick.
examples.trans: 我弟弟免疫系统很强，所以很少生病。

examples.sentence: Eating fresh fruit and sleeping well can help keep your immune system healthy.
examples.trans: 吃新鲜水果和睡好觉有助于保持免疫系统健康。

examples.sentence: Once you have had chickenpox, you are usually immune to it for the rest of your life.
examples.trans: 一旦得过水痘，你通常就会终身对其免疫。

examples.sentence: Despite the pressure from his teammates, he remained immune to their complaints and stuck to his plan.
examples.trans: 尽管队友们给他施加压力，他仍不受他们抱怨的影响，坚持自己的计划。

examples.sentence: No one is immune to criticism, but how we respond to it determines our growth.
examples.trans: 没有人能免受批评，但我们如何回应批评决定了我们的成长。

examples.sentence: The study revealed that prolonged exposure to high levels of stress can weaken the immune system, making individuals more vulnerable to infections.
examples.trans: 该研究揭示，长期处于高压力环境中会削弱免疫系统，使个体更容易受到感染。

disease.usageZh: 可数名词，意为“疾病”。常与 prevent（预防）、develop（患上）、fight（对抗）、cure（治愈）、treat（治疗）等动词搭配。也可用于比喻，指社会或制度中的“弊病”。

examples.sentence: Washing your hands often is a good way to stop disease from spreading.
examples.trans: 勤洗手是阻止疾病传播的好方法。

examples.sentence: Doctors say that regular exercise can lower the risk of heart disease.
examples.trans: 医生说经常锻炼可以降低患心脏病的风险。

examples.sentence: The government has launched a campaign to prevent the disease from spreading to other cities.
examples.trans: 政府发起了一场运动，以防止这种疾病传播到其他城市。

examples.sentence: Researchers have identified a gene that may be responsible for the development of this rare disease.
examples.trans: 研究人员已经确定了一个可能导致这种罕见疾病发生的基因。

examples.sentence: While modern medicine has cured many infectious diseases, lifestyle-related diseases remain a major challenge worldwide.
examples.trans: 尽管现代医学已经治愈了许多传染病，但与生活方式相关的疾病仍然是全球面临的重大挑战。

examples.sentence: The outbreak of the disease prompted health authorities to implement strict quarantine measures and accelerate vaccine distribution across the region.
examples.trans: 该疾病的暴发促使卫生部门实施严格的隔离措施，并加快该地区疫苗的分发。

guidelines.usageZh: 名词，通常以复数形式出现，意为“指导方针；准则”。常见搭配有 follow guidelines（遵循准则）、issue guidelines（发布准则）、safety guidelines（安全准则）。多用于正式或官方语境。

examples.sentence: The teacher gave us clear guidelines for the science project.
examples.trans: 老师给了我们科学项目的明确指导。

examples.sentence: You should follow the school guidelines when you use the computer room.
examples.trans: 使用电脑室时，你应该遵守学校的规定。

examples.sentence: The company has set strict guidelines to protect customers' personal information.
examples.trans: 公司制定了严格的准则来保护客户的个人信息。

examples.sentence: Before conducting the experiment, all students were required to read the laboratory safety guidelines thoroughly.
examples.trans: 在进行实验之前，所有学生都被要求仔细阅读实验室安全准则。

examples.sentence: The new guidelines, which were issued by the education department, aim to reduce the amount of homework assigned to primary school students.
examples.trans: 教育部门发布的新指导方针旨在减少小学生的作业量。

examples.sentence: Adhering to the clinical guidelines established by the World Health Organization is essential for ensuring the safe and effective treatment of infectious diseases.
examples.trans: 遵循世界卫生组织制定的临床指导方针对于确保传染病的安全有效治疗至关重要。

regular.usageZh: 形容词，意为“定期的，规律的”。常修饰名词，如 regular exercise（规律运动）、regular customer（常客）、regular check-up（定期体检）。也可表示“普通的，常规的”，如 regular size（常规尺寸）。

examples.sentence: I have a regular time for bed every night.
examples.trans: 我每天晚上都有固定的睡觉时间。

examples.sentence: She is a regular customer at the small coffee shop near our school.
examples.trans: 她是我们学校附近那家小咖啡店的常客。

examples.sentence: Taking regular breaks while studying helps you remember things better.
examples.trans: 学习时定期休息能帮助你更好地记住内容。

examples.sentence: The doctor advised him to do regular exercise rather than intense workouts once in a while.
examples.trans: 医生建议他做规律运动，而不是偶尔进行高强度锻炼。

examples.sentence: Unlike occasional volunteers, regular participants develop a deeper understanding of the community's needs.
examples.trans: 与偶尔参与的志愿者不同，定期参与者会对社区需求形成更深入的了解。

examples.sentence: Maintaining a regular sleep schedule, even on weekends, has been shown to improve both academic performance and emotional stability.
examples.trans: 即使在周末也保持规律的睡眠时间表，已被证明能同时提升学业表现和情绪稳定性。

physical.usageZh: 形容词，意为“身体的，肉体的”，常与 health、activity、exercise、strength 等词搭配。也可表示“物理的”或“物质的”，如 physical world（物质世界）。在健康话题中与 mental（心理的）形成对比。

examples.sentence: Running and jumping are good physical activities.
examples.trans: 跑步和跳跃是很好的身体活动。

examples.sentence: Playing outside every day keeps your physical health strong.
examples.trans: 每天在户外玩耍能让你的身体保持强壮。

examples.sentence: If you sit for too long without any physical movement, your back may start to hurt.
examples.trans: 如果你坐太久而不做任何身体活动，你的背可能会开始疼。

examples.sentence: Physical fitness is not just about looking good; it also affects how well you concentrate in class.
examples.trans: 身体健康不仅仅关乎外表，它还会影响你在课堂上的专注程度。

examples.sentence: While mental resilience is often praised, physical endurance remains equally vital for athletes competing at high levels.
examples.trans: 虽然心理韧性常被称赞，但身体耐力对高水平竞技的运动员来说同样至关重要。

examples.sentence: The study revealed a strong correlation between regular physical activity in adolescence and reduced risk of chronic illness in later life.
examples.trans: 该研究揭示了青春期规律的身体活动与晚年慢性病风险降低之间存在强相关性。

muscles.usageZh: 可数名词，通常用复数形式 muscles。常与 strong、weak、build、stretch、ache 等词搭配。可指具体的肌肉组织，也可比喻“力量，实力”，如 financial muscles（财力）。

examples.sentence: My leg muscles hurt after the long walk.
examples.trans: 走了很长的路后，我的腿部肌肉很疼。

examples.sentence: Swimming helps build strong muscles in your arms and shoulders.
examples.trans: 游泳有助于锻炼你手臂和肩膀的强壮肌肉。

examples.sentence: When you lift heavy things, your muscles need time to rest and grow stronger.
examples.trans: 当你搬重物时，你的肌肉需要时间休息并变得更强壮。

examples.sentence: Stretching before exercise warms up your muscles and reduces the chance of injury.
examples.trans: 运动前拉伸能让肌肉热身，并降低受伤的可能性。

examples.sentence: Unlike fat tissue, muscles burn calories even when the body is at rest, which is why strength training boosts metabolism.
examples.trans: 与脂肪组织不同，肌肉即使在身体休息时也会消耗热量，这就是力量训练能提升新陈代谢的原因。

examples.sentence: Prolonged inactivity causes muscles to atrophy, leading to a decline in both physical strength and metabolic efficiency.
examples.trans: 长期不活动会导致肌肉萎缩，进而造成体力和代谢效率的双重下降。

mood.usageZh: 可数名词，常与 in a ... mood 搭配表示“处于某种情绪中”，如 in a good/bad mood。也可作主语或宾语，如 improve/lift one's mood。口语和书面语都常用。

family.meaning: 情绪多变的，闷闷不乐的
情绪低落地，闷闷不乐地

examples.sentence: My sister is in a good mood after eating ice cream.
examples.trans: 我妹妹吃完冰淇淋后心情很好。

examples.sentence: Rainy days always put me in a quiet mood.
examples.trans: 下雨天总是让我心情安静下来。

examples.sentence: A short walk outside can lift your mood when you feel tired.
examples.trans: 当你感到累的时候，出去走一小段路能让你心情好起来。

examples.sentence: The cheerful music at the party instantly changed the mood of the whole room.
examples.trans: 派对上欢快的音乐立刻改变了整个房间的气氛。

examples.sentence: Rather than forcing yourself to work when you are in a low mood, it is often wiser to take a short break.
examples.trans: 与其在情绪低落时强迫自己工作，不如短暂休息一下，这往往更明智。

examples.sentence: The study suggests that regular exposure to natural light can significantly stabilize one's mood, especially during the winter months.
examples.trans: 研究表明，经常接触自然光能显著稳定人的情绪，尤其是在冬季。

workout.usageZh: 可数名词，指一次具体的锻炼或训练，常与 do/have/complete 搭配，如 do a workout。也可指健身计划中的一节训练课。口语中常用。

examples.sentence: I do a quick workout in my room every morning.
examples.trans: 我每天早上在房间里快速锻炼一下。

examples.sentence: My dad likes to have a light workout before breakfast.
examples.trans: 我爸爸喜欢在早餐前做一次轻度的锻炼。

examples.sentence: After a hard workout, you should drink enough water to recover.
examples.trans: 剧烈锻炼后，你应该喝足够的水来恢复。

examples.sentence: She designed a 20-minute home workout that requires no equipment at all.
examples.trans: 她设计了一套20分钟的家庭锻炼方案，完全不需要任何器械。

examples.sentence: Although a high-intensity workout can burn more calories, it may not be suitable for people with joint problems.
examples.trans: 虽然高强度锻炼能燃烧更多热量，但可能不适合有关节问题的人。

examples.sentence: Evidence indicates that completing a moderate workout in the late afternoon can improve both sleep quality and next-day alertness.
examples.trans: 有证据表明，在傍晚完成一次中等强度的锻炼可以同时改善睡眠质量和第二天的警觉度。

individual.usageZh: 可数名词，指“个人、个体”，常与 group 或 society 相对。也可作形容词，表示“个别的、单独的”，如 individual needs, individual differences。正式程度中等，书面和口语都可用。

examples.sentence: Each individual in our class has a different favorite sport.
examples.trans: 我们班每个人喜欢的运动都不一样。

examples.sentence: The coach gives individual advice to every player after the game.
examples.trans: 比赛后，教练给每个队员单独提出建议。

examples.sentence: Every individual should take responsibility for protecting the environment.
examples.trans: 每个人都应该为保护环境承担责任。

examples.sentence: The program is designed to meet the individual learning needs of each student rather than treating the class as one group.
examples.trans: 该项目旨在满足每个学生个体的学习需求，而不是把全班当作一个整体来对待。

examples.sentence: While teamwork is essential in modern companies, the contribution of each individual should never be overlooked.
examples.trans: 虽然团队合作在现代公司中至关重要，但每个个体的贡献也不应被忽视。

examples.sentence: A society that values the freedom of the individual must also ensure that personal choices do not harm the collective well-being.
examples.trans: 一个重视个人自由的社会，也必须确保个人选择不会损害集体福祉。

role.usageZh: 可数名词，表示“作用”或“角色”。常见搭配：play a role in...（在……中起作用）、take on a role（承担角色）、the role of...（……的角色/作用）。既可用于日常生活，也可用于正式书面语。

examples.sentence: My mom plays an important role in our family.
examples.trans: 我妈妈在我们家起着重要作用。

examples.sentence: The Internet plays a bigger and bigger role in our daily life.
examples.trans: 互联网在我们的日常生活中扮演着越来越重要的角色。

examples.sentence: As a monitor, she has learned to take on the role of a leader.
examples.trans: 作为班长，她学会了承担领导者的角色。

examples.sentence: Regular exercise plays a vital role in maintaining both physical and mental health.
examples.trans: 经常锻炼在维持身心健康方面起着至关重要的作用。

examples.sentence: It was not until he joined the debate team that he truly understood the role of logical reasoning in persuasion.
examples.trans: 直到加入辩论队，他才真正理解逻辑推理在说服中的作用。

examples.sentence: The role that cultural heritage plays in shaping a nation's identity cannot be overstated, particularly in an era of rapid globalization.
examples.trans: 文化遗产在塑造国家认同方面的作用怎么强调都不为过，尤其是在快速全球化的时代。

recovering.usageZh: 动名词或现在分词，表示“正在恢复”。常见搭配：be recovering from...（正从……中恢复）、recovering patient（正在康复的病人）。作定语时放在名词前，作表语时常与 from 连用。

examples.sentence: My grandpa is recovering from a cold at home.
examples.trans: 我爷爷正在家里从感冒中恢复。

examples.sentence: The boy is recovering quickly after taking the medicine.
examples.trans: 吃了药之后，这个男孩恢复得很快。

examples.sentence: She is still recovering from the long illness, so she can't go back to school yet.
examples.trans: 她仍在从久病中恢复，所以还不能回学校。

examples.sentence: Having spent three weeks in hospital, the athlete is now recovering steadily and hopes to return to training next month.
examples.trans: 住院三周后，这位运动员正在稳步恢复，希望下个月能恢复训练。

examples.sentence: While recovering from the surgery, she developed a deeper appreciation for the patience and care shown by the nursing staff.
examples.trans: 在手术恢复期间，她对护理人员表现出的耐心和关怀产生了更深的感激之情。

examples.sentence: The economy, though recovering from the recession, still faces structural challenges that require long-term policy adjustments.
examples.trans: 经济虽然正在从衰退中复苏，但仍面临需要长期政策调整的结构性挑战。

aids.usageZh: 动词第三人称单数形式，表示“帮助，辅助”。常见搭配：aid in (doing) something（有助于做某事）、aid somebody in/with something（在某事上帮助某人）。比 help 更正式，常用于书面语或说明性文字。

examples.sentence: A good dictionary aids my English learning.
examples.trans: 一本好词典帮助我学英语。

examples.sentence: Listening to English songs aids in remembering new words.
examples.trans: 听英文歌曲有助于记住新单词。

examples.sentence: Taking notes carefully in class aids students in reviewing after school.
examples.trans: 课堂上认真记笔记有助于学生课后复习。

examples.sentence: Regular exposure to authentic language materials aids learners in developing a natural sense of sentence rhythm.
examples.trans: 经常接触真实的语言材料有助于学习者培养自然的句子节奏感。

examples.sentence: Unlike passive memorization, active recall aids in transferring knowledge from short-term to long-term memory.
examples.trans: 与被动记忆不同，主动回忆有助于将知识从短期记忆转化为长期记忆。

examples.sentence: The implementation of transparent evaluation systems aids in fostering public trust in government institutions, which in turn promotes social stability.
examples.trans: 实施透明的评估制度有助于培养公众对政府机构的信任，进而促进社会稳定。

maintain.usageZh: 及物动词，后接名词或名词短语，表示“保持、维持”某种状态、关系或事物。常见搭配：maintain health（保持健康）、maintain a relationship（维持关系）、maintain balance（保持平衡）。可用于正式或书面语体。

examples.sentence: I try to maintain a clean desk every day.
examples.trans: 我每天尽量保持书桌干净。

examples.sentence: You need to maintain your bike so it runs well.
examples.trans: 你需要保养你的自行车，这样它才能骑得顺。

examples.sentence: She works hard to maintain good grades in all subjects.
examples.trans: 她努力学习，以保持各科成绩优秀。

examples.sentence: To maintain a healthy weight, you should combine regular exercise with a sensible diet.
examples.trans: 为了保持健康的体重，你应该把规律运动和合理饮食结合起来。

examples.sentence: Despite the pressure from his peers, he managed to maintain his own opinion on the matter.
examples.trans: 尽管有来自同伴的压力，他仍然在这个问题上保持了自己的看法。

examples.sentence: Maintaining a long-distance friendship requires consistent effort from both sides, yet the emotional reward often outweighs the inconvenience.
examples.trans: 维持一段异地友谊需要双方持续付出努力，但情感上的回报往往大于不便。

balanced.usageZh: 形容词，常修饰 diet（饮食）、life（生活）、view（观点）、approach（方法）等名词，表示各方面比例适当、不偏激。常见搭配：a balanced diet（均衡饮食）、a balanced view（全面的看法）。

examples.sentence: My mom says a balanced breakfast helps me study better.
examples.trans: 我妈妈说均衡的早餐能帮助我学习更好。

examples.sentence: Eating a balanced meal with rice, vegetables, and fish is good for you.
examples.trans: 吃一顿有米饭、蔬菜和鱼的均衡饭菜对你有好处。

examples.sentence: A balanced schedule leaves time for both homework and rest.
examples.trans: 均衡的时间安排能留出做作业和休息的时间。

examples.sentence: The report presents a balanced view of the advantages and risks of online learning.
examples.trans: 这份报告对在线学习的优点和风险提出了一个全面的看法。

examples.sentence: A balanced approach to screen time, rather than a total ban, tends to be more effective for teenagers.
examples.trans: 对青少年来说，平衡地管理屏幕时间往往比完全禁止更有效。

examples.sentence: In an era of information overload, the ability to form a balanced judgment based on reliable sources has become increasingly valuable.
examples.trans: 在信息过载的时代，基于可靠来源形成均衡判断的能力变得越来越宝贵。

processed.usageZh: 形容词，通常用于描述经过工业加工的食物，如 processed food（加工食品）、processed meat（加工肉类）。常含贬义，暗示添加了较多添加剂或营养流失。

examples.sentence: I like fresh fruit more than processed snacks.
examples.trans: 比起加工零食，我更喜欢新鲜水果。

examples.sentence: Processed cheese can stay fresh for a long time.
examples.trans: 加工奶酪可以保存很长时间。

examples.sentence: Doctors often advise people to eat less processed food and more vegetables.
examples.trans: 医生经常建议人们少吃加工食品，多吃蔬菜。

examples.sentence: Reading food labels carefully helps you avoid highly processed products with too much salt and sugar.
examples.trans: 仔细阅读食品标签有助于你避免含过多盐和糖的高度加工产品。

examples.sentence: While processed foods offer convenience, their long-term impact on health has raised growing concern among nutritionists.
examples.trans: 虽然加工食品提供了便利，但它们对健康的长期影响已引起营养学家越来越多的担忧。

examples.sentence: The shift from traditional diets to heavily processed alternatives has been linked to a rise in chronic diseases across many developing countries.
examples.trans: 从传统饮食向高度加工替代品的转变，已被认为与许多发展中国家慢性病发病率上升有关。

function.usageZh: 动词或名词。作动词时不及物，常与 properly、well、normally 搭配，表示“正常运转”。作名词时常用 the function of... 表示“……的功能”。动词用法在书面语中更常见。

examples.sentence: My phone doesn't function when the battery is dead.
examples.trans: 电池没电时，我的手机就不能用了。

examples.sentence: The brain functions best when you get enough sleep.
examples.trans: 当你睡眠充足时，大脑运转得最好。

examples.sentence: The new machine functions well even in very cold weather.
examples.trans: 这台新机器即使在非常寒冷的天气里也能正常运转。

examples.sentence: The committee cannot function effectively without clear rules to guide its decisions.
examples.trans: 没有明确的规则来指导决策，委员会就无法有效运作。

examples.sentence: Unlike a traditional library, this digital platform functions as both a reading space and a social network.
examples.trans: 与传统图书馆不同，这个数字平台既是一个阅读空间，也是一个社交网络。

examples.sentence: A society functions smoothly only when its members share a basic sense of trust in public institutions.
examples.trans: 只有当社会成员对公共机构怀有基本的信任感时，社会才能顺畅运转。

replace.usageZh: 及物动词。常用结构 replace A with B，表示“用B替换A”。也可表示“把……放回原处”。在谈论补充水分或能量时，可说 replace fluids / replace energy。

examples.sentence: Please replace the book on the shelf when you finish it.
examples.trans: 看完后请把书放回书架上。

examples.sentence: We decided to replace the old sofa with a bigger one.
examples.trans: 我们决定用一个大一点的沙发替换旧沙发。

examples.sentence: After running for an hour, you should replace the water your body has lost.
examples.trans: 跑了一个小时后，你应该补充身体流失的水分。

examples.sentence: The company plans to replace its outdated software with a system that can handle larger amounts of data.
examples.trans: 公司计划用一套能处理更大数据量的系统来替换过时的软件。

examples.sentence: No amount of digital communication can fully replace the warmth of a face-to-face conversation.
examples.trans: 再多的数字交流也无法完全取代面对面交谈的温暖。

examples.sentence: As automation spreads through the industry, the fear that machines will replace human workers has become a central topic of public debate.
examples.trans: 随着自动化在行业中普及，机器将取代人类工人的担忧已成为公众讨论的核心话题。

germs.usageZh: 通常用作复数名词，泛指能引起疾病的微生物。常与 spread、kill、remove、carry 等动词搭配。口语中也可说 pick up germs，表示“染上细菌”。

examples.sentence: Cover your mouth when you sneeze so germs don't spread.
examples.trans: 打喷嚏时捂住嘴，这样细菌就不会传播。

examples.sentence: Washing your hands with soap helps remove germs from your skin.
examples.trans: 用肥皂洗手有助于去除皮肤上的细菌。

examples.sentence: Germs can live on surfaces like door handles for several hours.
examples.trans: 细菌可以在门把手等表面上存活数小时。

examples.sentence: Scientists have discovered that some germs in the human body actually help with digestion.
examples.trans: 科学家发现，人体内的一些细菌实际上有助于消化。

examples.sentence: While most people associate germs with disease, a large number of them are harmless or even beneficial to human health.
examples.trans: 虽然大多数人把细菌与疾病联系在一起，但大量细菌对人体健康无害，甚至有益。

examples.sentence: The overuse of antibacterial products may kill harmless germs and, in the long run, weaken the body's natural defenses against infection.
examples.trans: 过度使用抗菌产品可能会杀死无害细菌，从长远来看会削弱人体抵抗感染的天然防御能力。

hormones.usageZh: 可数名词，通常用复数形式，表示“激素，荷尔蒙”。常见搭配：release hormones（释放激素）、hormone levels（激素水平）、growth hormone（生长激素）。多用于生物、医学和健康话题，语体偏正式。

examples.sentence: Teenagers' bodies make more hormones as they grow.
examples.trans: 青少年在成长时身体会产生更多激素。

examples.sentence: Hormones control many things, such as sleep, hunger, and mood.
examples.trans: 激素控制着很多事情，比如睡眠、饥饿和情绪。

examples.sentence: When you exercise, your brain releases hormones that make you feel happier.
examples.trans: 当你运动时，大脑会释放让你感觉更快乐的激素。

examples.sentence: A lack of certain hormones can lead to serious health problems, including tiredness and weight gain.
examples.trans: 缺乏某些激素会导致严重的健康问题，包括疲劳和体重增加。

examples.sentence: Unlike nerves, which send fast electrical signals, hormones travel through the blood and produce slower but longer-lasting effects.
examples.trans: 与发送快速电信号的神经不同，激素通过血液传播，产生更慢但更持久的效果。

examples.sentence: Researchers have found that chronic sleep loss disturbs the balance of hormones that regulate appetite, which may explain why tired people often overeat.
examples.trans: 研究人员发现，长期睡眠不足会扰乱调节食欲的激素平衡，这或许能解释为什么疲惫的人常常暴饮暴食。

viruses.usageZh: 通常用作复数名词，指比细菌更小、需要寄生在活细胞内的病原体。常见搭配：computer viruses（计算机病毒）、deadly viruses（致命病毒）、viruses spread（病毒传播）。

examples.sentence: Wash your hands often so you don't catch viruses.
examples.trans: 勤洗手，这样你就不会感染病毒。

examples.sentence: Some viruses can live on your phone for a whole day.
examples.trans: 有些病毒可以在你的手机上存活一整天。

examples.sentence: Doctors say that covering your mouth when you cough helps stop viruses from spreading.
examples.trans: 医生说，咳嗽时捂住嘴有助于阻止病毒传播。

examples.sentence: Unlike bacteria, viruses cannot reproduce on their own and must enter a host cell to survive.
examples.trans: 与细菌不同，病毒无法自行繁殖，必须进入宿主细胞才能存活。

examples.sentence: Although antibiotics are useless against viruses, antiviral drugs can sometimes slow down their replication.
examples.trans: 尽管抗生素对病毒无效，但抗病毒药物有时能减缓它们的复制。

examples.sentence: The rapid mutation of certain viruses poses a major challenge for vaccine development, as immunity gained from one strain may not protect against another.
examples.trans: 某些病毒的快速变异给疫苗研发带来了重大挑战，因为针对一种毒株获得的免疫力可能无法抵御另一种毒株。

essential.usageZh: 形容词，表示“必不可少的，极其重要的”。常见搭配：be essential to/for something（对……至关重要）、it is essential that...（……是至关重要的）。语体较正式，可用于日常和学术语境。

examples.sentence: Water is essential for plants to grow.
examples.trans: 水对植物生长是必不可少的。

examples.sentence: A good night's sleep is essential if you want to do well in the exam tomorrow.
examples.trans: 如果你想明天考好，睡个好觉是必不可少的。

examples.sentence: Learning how to manage your time is essential for balancing schoolwork and hobbies.
examples.trans: 学会管理时间对于平衡学业和爱好至关重要。

examples.sentence: It is essential that all passengers fasten their seat belts before the plane takes off.
examples.trans: 所有乘客在飞机起飞前系好安全带是至关重要的。

examples.sentence: Trust is essential to any lasting relationship, yet it takes years to build and only seconds to destroy.
examples.trans: 信任对任何长久的关系都至关重要，但它需要多年建立，却只需几秒就能摧毁。

examples.sentence: While technical skills are essential for career success, the ability to communicate clearly and work with others is often what distinguishes outstanding professionals from average ones.
examples.trans: 虽然技术技能对职业成功必不可少，但清晰沟通和与他人合作的能力往往是杰出专业人士与普通人的区别所在。

properly.usageZh: 副词，修饰动词，表示“正确地、适当地”。常与 do, use, work, wear 等动词搭配。口语和书面语都常用，语气比 correctly 更侧重“合适、得体”。

examples.sentence: Wash your hands properly before you eat.
examples.trans: 吃饭前要好好洗手。

examples.sentence: The machine won't work properly if you put the batteries in the wrong way.
examples.trans: 如果你把电池装反了，这台机器就无法正常运转。

examples.sentence: Make sure you tie your shoelaces properly, or you might trip while running.
examples.trans: 一定要把鞋带系好，否则跑步时可能会绊倒。

examples.sentence: Having been trained properly, the new staff quickly adapted to the company's workflow.
examples.trans: 经过适当培训后，新员工很快适应了公司的工作流程。

examples.sentence: Properly handled, this seemingly minor complaint could have been resolved within a day.
examples.trans: 如果处理得当，这个看似微不足道的投诉本可以在一天内解决。

examples.sentence: The data cannot be properly interpreted unless the sampling method is taken into account.
examples.trans: 除非把抽样方法考虑在内，否则这些数据无法得到正确解读。

prepare.usageZh: 及物动词，常用结构：prepare sth（准备某物）、prepare for sth（为某事做准备）、prepare to do sth（准备做某事）。也可作不及物动词。口语和书面语都常用。

examples.sentence: Mum is preparing breakfast in the kitchen.
examples.trans: 妈妈正在厨房里准备早餐。

examples.sentence: We need to prepare a short speech for the school meeting next Monday.
examples.trans: 我们需要为下周一的全校大会准备一个简短的发言。

examples.sentence: Before the exam, she prepared a list of key points to review.
examples.trans: 考试前，她准备了一份要点清单来复习。

examples.sentence: The team spent the entire weekend preparing the final report for the board meeting.
examples.trans: 团队花了整个周末为董事会会议准备最终报告。

examples.sentence: Rather than waiting for instructions, she took the initiative to prepare a detailed project outline.
examples.trans: 她没有等待指示，而是主动准备了一份详细的项目大纲。

examples.sentence: Universities are now expected to prepare students not merely for exams, but for the complexities of real-world problem-solving.
examples.trans: 如今，大学被期望不仅让学生为考试做好准备，还要让他们为现实世界中复杂的问题解决做好准备。

toilet.usageZh: 可数名词，指“厕所、卫生间”或“马桶”。英式英语中常指卫生间，美式英语中 bathroom 更常用。常见搭配：flush the toilet（冲马桶）、public toilet（公共厕所）。

examples.sentence: The toilet is at the end of the hallway.
examples.trans: 厕所就在走廊的尽头。

examples.sentence: Remember to flush the toilet after you use it.
examples.trans: 用完马桶后记得冲水。

examples.sentence: The restaurant's toilet was so clean that it surprised all the customers.
examples.trans: 那家餐厅的厕所非常干净，让所有顾客都感到惊讶。

examples.sentence: Having access to a clean toilet is something many people take for granted.
examples.trans: 能够使用干净的厕所是许多人习以为常的事情。

examples.sentence: The lack of proper toilet facilities in rural schools remains a pressing issue in many developing regions.
examples.trans: 农村学校缺乏完善的厕所设施在许多发展中地区仍然是一个紧迫的问题。

examples.sentence: Public health campaigns emphasize that safe toilet usage is as crucial to disease prevention as clean drinking water.
examples.trans: 公共卫生宣传活动强调，安全使用厕所与清洁饮用水一样，对疾病预防至关重要。

sneezing.usageZh: 动名词或现在分词，表示打喷嚏的动作。常与 start、stop、keep、can't help 等动词连用；也可作主语或介词宾语。口语中常用 'sneezing fit' 表示一阵连续打喷嚏。

family.meaning: 老打喷嚏的；引起喷嚏的

examples.sentence: My little brother keeps sneezing because of the cat.
examples.trans: 我弟弟因为那只猫一直打喷嚏。

examples.sentence: Sneezing in public without covering your mouth is not polite.
examples.trans: 在公共场合打喷嚏不捂嘴是不礼貌的。

examples.sentence: She started sneezing the moment she walked into the dusty old room.
examples.trans: 她一走进那间布满灰尘的旧房间就开始打喷嚏。

examples.sentence: Sneezing repeatedly can be a sign that you are allergic to something in the air.
examples.trans: 反复打喷嚏可能是你对空气中的某种东西过敏的信号。

examples.sentence: Unlike a cough, which can sometimes be controlled, sneezing is almost impossible to stop once it starts.
examples.trans: 与有时可以控制的咳嗽不同，打喷嚏一旦开始几乎不可能停下来。

examples.sentence: The sudden burst of sneezing during the meeting drew everyone's attention, leaving her embarrassed and eager to escape the room.
examples.trans: 会议期间突然爆发的一阵喷嚏吸引了所有人的注意，让她尴尬不已，急于逃离房间。

waste.usageZh: 不可数名词，指废弃物、垃圾或动物排泄物。常见搭配：household waste（生活垃圾）、kitchen waste（厨余垃圾）、waste disposal（废物处理）、waste bin（垃圾桶）。注意与动词 waste（浪费）区分。

examples.sentence: Please throw the waste into the bin.
examples.trans: 请把垃圾扔进垃圾桶里。

examples.sentence: We should separate kitchen waste from paper and plastic.
examples.trans: 我们应该把厨余垃圾和纸张、塑料分开。

examples.sentence: The factory was fined for dumping chemical waste into the river.
examples.trans: 那家工厂因向河里倾倒化学废料而被罚款。

examples.sentence: Reducing food waste at home starts with planning meals before you go shopping.
examples.trans: 减少家庭食物浪费要从购物前规划好每顿饭开始。

examples.sentence: While recycling helps reduce the amount of waste sent to landfills, the most effective solution is to produce less waste in the first place.
examples.trans: 虽然回收利用有助于减少送往垃圾填埋场的废物量，但最有效的解决办法是从一开始就少产生垃圾。

examples.sentence: The improper handling of medical waste poses a severe threat to public health, as contaminated materials can easily spread infections if not disposed of correctly.
examples.trans: 医疗废物的不当处理对公共健康构成严重威胁，因为受污染的材料如果处置不当很容易传播感染。

soap.usageZh: 通常作不可数名词，指肥皂这种物质；指具体的一块肥皂时可用 a bar of soap 或 a soap。常见搭配：liquid soap（洗手液/液体皂）、soap dish（肥皂盒）、soap bubbles（肥皂泡）。口语中 soap 也可指肥皂剧（soap opera）。

examples.sentence: Wash your hands with soap before dinner.
examples.trans: 晚饭前用肥皂洗手。

examples.sentence: There is a new bar of soap by the bathroom sink.
examples.trans: 浴室洗手池旁边有一块新肥皂。

examples.sentence: The soap slipped out of my hand and fell into the bathtub.
examples.trans: 肥皂从我手里滑落，掉进了浴缸里。

examples.sentence: Doctors recommend using liquid soap instead of bar soap in shared bathrooms to reduce the spread of germs.
examples.trans: 医生建议在共用浴室使用洗手液而不是块状肥皂，以减少细菌传播。

examples.sentence: Although plain soap does not kill all bacteria, it effectively removes them from the skin when combined with proper hand-washing techniques.
examples.trans: 尽管普通肥皂不能杀死所有细菌，但配合正确的洗手方法，它能有效地将细菌从皮肤上清除。

examples.sentence: The discovery that soap molecules can break down the fatty membrane of certain viruses has reinforced the importance of this simple hygiene practice in disease prevention.
examples.trans: 肥皂分子能够破坏某些病毒的脂肪膜这一发现，进一步证明了这种简单的卫生习惯在疾病预防中的重要性。

fingernails.usageZh: 可数名词，通常以复数形式出现。指手指甲，脚趾甲是 toenails。常见搭配：bite one's fingernails（咬指甲）、paint one's fingernails（涂指甲油）、trim/cut one's fingernails（剪指甲）。

examples.sentence: My fingernails are too long, so I need to cut them.
examples.trans: 我的指甲太长了，所以我需要剪一剪。

examples.sentence: She painted her fingernails bright red for the school party.
examples.trans: 她为学校聚会把指甲涂成了鲜红色。

examples.sentence: The doctor checked his fingernails to see if he was getting enough iron.
examples.trans: 医生检查了他的指甲，看他是否摄入了足够的铁。

examples.sentence: Biting your fingernails is a hard habit to break, especially when you feel nervous.
examples.trans: 咬指甲是一个很难改掉的习惯，尤其是当你感到紧张的时候。

examples.sentence: Unlike painted fingernails, which can chip easily, natural nails require almost no daily care.
examples.trans: 与容易脱落的涂色指甲不同，自然指甲几乎不需要日常打理。

examples.sentence: The forensic team collected fingernail samples from the scene, hoping to find traces of the suspect's DNA.
examples.trans: 法医小组从现场采集了指甲样本，希望找到嫌疑人DNA的痕迹。

towel.usageZh: 可数名词，一块毛巾是 a towel。常见搭配：bath towel（浴巾）、hand towel（擦手巾）、paper towel（纸巾）、throw in the towel（认输，放弃）。也可作动词，表示“用毛巾擦干”。

examples.sentence: I need a dry towel to clean my hands.
examples.trans: 我需要一条干毛巾来擦手。

examples.sentence: He hung the wet towel on the back of the chair to let it dry.
examples.trans: 他把湿毛巾挂在椅背上让它晾干。

examples.sentence: If you forget your towel at the swimming pool, you can borrow one from the front desk.
examples.trans: 如果你在游泳池忘了带毛巾，可以向前台借一条。

examples.sentence: Having grabbed a towel from the bathroom, she rushed to answer the door before the visitor left.
examples.trans: 她从浴室抓了一条毛巾，赶在访客离开前冲过去开门。

examples.sentence: A good-quality cotton towel absorbs water far better than a cheap synthetic one does.
examples.trans: 一条优质棉毛巾的吸水能力远胜于廉价的合成纤维毛巾。

examples.sentence: Rather than throwing in the towel when the experiment failed, the researchers adjusted their method and tried again.
examples.trans: 实验失败后，研究人员并没有认输，而是调整了方法重新尝试。

impossible.usageZh: 形容词，表示“不可能的”。常用句型：It is impossible to do something（做某事是不可能的）、find something impossible（觉得某事不可能）、make it impossible for somebody to do something（使某人无法做某事）。反义词是 possible。

examples.sentence: It is impossible for a fish to live without water.
examples.trans: 鱼没有水是不可能存活的。

examples.sentence: The maths problem looked impossible at first, but I solved it in the end.
examples.trans: 这道数学题起初看起来不可能做出来，但我最终还是解出来了。

examples.sentence: It is almost impossible to find a seat on the bus during rush hour.
examples.trans: 在高峰时段，公交车上几乎不可能找到座位。

examples.sentence: The heavy snow made it impossible for the rescue team to reach the village before dark.
examples.trans: 大雪使救援队无法在天黑前到达那个村庄。

examples.sentence: What seems impossible today may become routine tomorrow, given the speed of technological change.
examples.trans: 考虑到技术变革的速度，今天看似不可能的事明天可能就变得稀松平常。

examples.sentence: The committee concluded that meeting both the deadline and the budget requirement was impossible without cutting corners.
examples.trans: 委员会得出结论：既要赶上截止日期又要满足预算要求，不偷工减料是不可能的。

transfer.usageZh: 可作名词或动词。作动词时常用结构：transfer something (from A) to B，表示“把某物从A转移到B”。作名词时指转移、调动或换乘。常见搭配：data transfer（数据传输）、transfer student（转学生）、bank transfer（银行转账）。

examples.sentence: Can you transfer the pictures from your phone to my computer?
examples.trans: 你能把照片从你手机传到我的电脑上吗？

examples.sentence: We need to transfer the fish to a bigger tank before it grows too large.
examples.trans: 我们需要在鱼长得太大之前把它转移到一个更大的鱼缸里。

examples.sentence: If you take the subway, you have to transfer to Line 10 at the next station.
examples.trans: 如果你坐地铁，你得在下一站换乘10号线。

examples.sentence: The company decided to transfer its headquarters to Shanghai in order to attract more international talent.
examples.trans: 公司决定将总部迁至上海，以吸引更多国际人才。

examples.sentence: Heat will naturally transfer from a warmer object to a cooler one until both reach the same temperature.
examples.trans: 热量会自然地从较热的物体传递到较冷的物体，直到两者达到相同温度。

examples.sentence: The ability to transfer theoretical knowledge into practical skills is what distinguishes outstanding engineers from average ones.
examples.trans: 将理论知识转化为实践技能的能力，正是杰出工程师与普通工程师的区别所在。

frequently.usageZh: 副词，用于修饰动词，表示动作发生的频率高。常见搭配：frequently asked questions（常见问题）、occur frequently（频繁发生）、frequently used（常用的）。语体上偏正式，口语中常可用often替代。

examples.sentence: My little brother frequently forgets where he puts his schoolbag.
examples.trans: 我弟弟经常忘记他把书包放在哪里。

examples.sentence: She frequently visits her grandparents on weekends because they live nearby.
examples.trans: 她经常在周末去看望祖父母，因为他们住得很近。

examples.sentence: People who frequently stay up late are more likely to get sick than those who sleep regularly.
examples.trans: 经常熬夜的人比作息规律的人更容易生病。

examples.sentence: Students who frequently participate in class discussions tend to develop stronger critical thinking skills.
examples.trans: 经常参与课堂讨论的学生往往能培养出更强的批判性思维能力。

examples.sentence: Frequently cited as one of the greatest novels of the 20th century, the book continues to influence writers today.
examples.trans: 这部小说经常被列为20世纪最伟大的作品之一，至今仍在影响着当代作家。

examples.sentence: In regions where earthquakes occur frequently, buildings are designed with flexible structures that can absorb seismic shocks.
examples.trans: 在地震频繁发生的地区，建筑设计采用柔性结构，以吸收地震冲击。

limit.usageZh: 及物动词，直接接宾语，表示“限制、限定”。常用结构：limit sth to sth（把某物限制在……范围内）。也可作名词，表示“限度、界限”，常见短语：speed limit（限速）、time limit（时间限制）。

examples.sentence: My mom limits my video game time to one hour a day.
examples.trans: 我妈妈把我每天打游戏的时间限制在一小时以内。

examples.sentence: The school limits the number of students in each club to twenty.
examples.trans: 学校把每个社团的学生人数限制在二十人以内。

examples.sentence: To stay healthy, you should limit the amount of sugar you eat every day.
examples.trans: 为了保持健康，你应该限制每天摄入的糖分。

examples.sentence: The new policy limits how much water each household can use during the dry season.
examples.trans: 新政策限制了每户家庭在旱季的用水量。

examples.sentence: Rather than limiting students' creativity, the project encourages them to explore ideas beyond the textbook.
examples.trans: 这个项目并没有限制学生的创造力，反而鼓励他们探索课本之外的想法。

examples.sentence: While regulations are necessary to limit industrial pollution, they must be designed so as not to hinder economic growth.
examples.trans: 虽然限制工业污染的法规是必要的，但其设计必须避免阻碍经济增长。

average.usageZh: 形容词，意为“平均的”或“普通的、一般的”。也可作名词，意为“平均数、平均水平”。常用短语：on average（平均而言）、above/below average（高于/低于平均水平）。作动词时意为“平均为”。

examples.sentence: The average height of the boys in my class is 160 cm.
examples.trans: 我们班男生的平均身高是160厘米。

examples.sentence: On average, I spend about thirty minutes walking to school every day.
examples.trans: 平均而言，我每天大约花三十分钟步行去学校。

examples.sentence: The average student in our grade reads at least two books every month.
examples.trans: 我们年级的普通学生每个月至少读两本书。

examples.sentence: Compared with last year, the average amount of time people spend on mobile phones has increased by nearly two hours a week.
examples.trans: 与去年相比，人们每周花在手机上的平均时间增加了近两个小时。

examples.sentence: Although his test scores are above average, what truly sets him apart is his ability to apply knowledge to real-world problems.
examples.trans: 尽管他的考试成绩高于平均水平，但真正让他脱颖而出的是他将知识应用于现实问题的能力。

examples.sentence: The study reveals that the average household in urban areas consumes nearly twice as much electricity as its rural counterpart, a gap that has widened over the past decade.
examples.trans: 研究显示，城市家庭的平均用电量几乎是农村家庭的两倍，这一差距在过去十年中持续扩大。

apply.usageZh: 及物动词，常用结构 apply sth to sth，表示“把某物涂抹/应用到某物上”。也可表示“申请”，后接 for。语体中性，口语和书面语均常见。

examples.sentence: Apply some cream to your face before bed.
examples.trans: 睡觉前往脸上涂点面霜。

examples.sentence: You need to apply glue to both sides of the paper and press them together.
examples.trans: 你需要在纸的两面都涂上胶水，然后把它们压在一起。

examples.sentence: If you apply the medicine twice a day, the cut will heal much faster.
examples.trans: 如果你每天涂两次药，伤口会愈合得快得多。

examples.sentence: The new coating is applied to the surface to prevent it from rusting.
examples.trans: 这种新涂层被涂在表面上，以防止其生锈。

examples.sentence: Rather than applying more pressure, the engineer suggested adjusting the angle of contact.
examples.trans: 工程师没有施加更大的压力，而是建议调整接触角度。

examples.sentence: The principle, once applied consistently across all departments, yielded measurable improvements in efficiency.
examples.trans: 这一原则一旦在所有部门持续应用，便带来了可衡量的效率提升。

rub.usageZh: 及物或不及物动词，常用搭配 rub sth with sth、rub sth together、rub sth off。可指用手、布等来回摩擦。语体偏口语，日常生活常用。

examples.sentence: Rub your hands together to keep them warm.
examples.trans: 搓搓手，让手暖和起来。

examples.sentence: She rubbed the window with a dry cloth until it shone.
examples.trans: 她用一块干布擦窗户，直到窗户发亮。

examples.sentence: Rub a little oil into the leather so that it stays soft and does not crack.
examples.trans: 往皮革里揉一点油，这样它就能保持柔软、不开裂。

examples.sentence: He rubbed the old coin gently with his thumb, trying to make out the date on it.
examples.trans: 他用拇指轻轻摩擦那枚旧硬币，想辨认出上面的日期。

examples.sentence: The stain refused to come off no matter how hard she rubbed at it with a wet sponge.
examples.trans: 无论她用湿海绵怎么用力擦，那块污渍都擦不掉。

examples.sentence: Rubbing the surface too vigorously can damage the protective layer, so a gentle circular motion is recommended.
examples.trans: 过于用力地摩擦表面会损坏保护层，因此建议采用轻柔的打圈方式。

wrists.usageZh: 可数名词，通常以复数形式 wrists 出现，指手腕部位。常用搭配：on one's wrists、grab sb by the wrists、flick one's wrists。语体中性。

examples.sentence: She wears a red band on her wrist.
examples.trans: 她手腕上戴着一根红色腕带。

examples.sentence: He fell off his bike and hurt both of his wrists.
examples.trans: 他从自行车上摔下来，两只手腕都受伤了。

examples.sentence: The doctor checked her wrists to see if the bones were in the right position.
examples.trans: 医生检查了她的手腕，看骨头是否在正确的位置。

examples.sentence: Gymnasts need strong wrists to support their body weight during handstands.
examples.trans: 体操运动员需要强壮的手腕来在倒立时支撑身体重量。

examples.sentence: Unlike the elbows, the wrists allow a wide range of fine movements, which is essential for playing the piano.
examples.trans: 与肘部不同，手腕允许大范围的精细动作，这对弹钢琴至关重要。

examples.sentence: Repetitive strain on the wrists, often caused by prolonged typing, can lead to chronic discomfort if left unaddressed.
examples.trans: 长时间打字常导致手腕反复劳损，若不加以处理，可能引发慢性不适。

fight with.usageZh: 动词短语，后接宾语（名词或名词短语）。通常表示对抗疾病、问题或对手。也可表示“与某人打架/争吵”，但本语境侧重“对抗、斗争”。

examples.sentence: My little brother sometimes fights with me over toys.
examples.trans: 我弟弟有时候跟我抢玩具。

examples.sentence: She had to fight with her fear of speaking in front of the class.
examples.trans: 她不得不克服在全班面前发言的恐惧。

examples.sentence: Many patients have to fight with pain every single day before they fully recover.
examples.trans: 许多病人在完全康复之前，每天都得与疼痛作斗争。

examples.sentence: The government is fighting with rising housing costs by introducing new policies.
examples.trans: 政府正在通过出台新政策来应对不断上涨的住房成本。

examples.sentence: Rather than fighting with every minor setback, successful people tend to focus on long-term goals.
examples.trans: 成功的人往往专注于长期目标，而不是与每一个小挫折较劲。

examples.sentence: For years, the small village fought with water shortages, yet its residents never gave up hope of building a better life.
examples.trans: 多年来，这个小村庄一直与缺水作斗争，但村民们从未放弃过上更好生活的希望。

develop habits.usageZh: 动词短语。'develop' 是及物动词，后接名词作宾语。常用于表示养成好习惯或坏习惯，强调习惯是逐渐形成的。

examples.sentence: I want to develop the habit of brushing my teeth twice a day.
examples.trans: 我想养成每天刷两次牙的习惯。

examples.sentence: It took me a month to develop the habit of drinking water before breakfast.
examples.trans: 我花了一个月才养成早餐前喝水的习惯。

examples.sentence: If you develop the habit of reviewing your notes every evening, you will remember much more.
examples.trans: 如果你养成每天晚上复习笔记的习惯，你会记住更多内容。

examples.sentence: Developing the habit of questioning what you read is essential for critical thinking.
examples.trans: 养成对所读内容提出质疑的习惯，对批判性思维至关重要。

examples.sentence: Once you develop the habit of exercising regularly, skipping a workout feels more uncomfortable than doing it.
examples.trans: 一旦你养成定期锻炼的习惯，跳过锻炼反而比锻炼更让你难受。

examples.sentence: Students who develop the habit of setting weekly goals tend to manage their time far more effectively than those who simply study whenever they feel like it.
examples.trans: 养成每周设定目标习惯的学生，往往比那些想学就学的学生更能有效管理时间。

balanced diet.usageZh: 名词短语。常用作主语或宾语。常与 'have', 'eat', 'follow', 'maintain', 'include' 等动词搭配。

examples.sentence: A balanced diet includes fruit, vegetables, rice, and meat.
examples.trans: 均衡饮食包括水果、蔬菜、米饭和肉。

examples.sentence: My mother says a balanced diet helps us grow strong and stay healthy.
examples.trans: 我妈妈说均衡饮食帮助我们长得强壮并保持健康。

examples.sentence: Eating a balanced diet is more important than taking vitamin pills every day.
examples.trans: 每天均衡饮食比吃维生素片更重要。

examples.sentence: A balanced diet, combined with regular exercise, plays a key role in preventing many common diseases.
examples.trans: 均衡饮食加上规律运动，在预防许多常见疾病方面起着关键作用。

examples.sentence: Contrary to popular belief, maintaining a balanced diet does not mean giving up all your favorite foods.
examples.trans: 与普遍看法相反，保持均衡饮食并不意味着放弃所有你喜欢的食物。

examples.sentence: Although a balanced diet alone cannot guarantee perfect health, it significantly lowers the risk of long-term illnesses such as diabetes and heart disease.
examples.trans: 虽然仅靠均衡饮食不能保证完全健康，但它能显著降低糖尿病和心脏病等长期疾病的风险。

processed foods.usageZh: 名词短语，通常用复数形式。常作主语或宾语，与 avoid、eat、contain、reduce 等动词搭配。多用于健康、饮食类话题，语体偏正式或说明性。

examples.sentence: My mom says processed foods are not good for us.
examples.trans: 我妈妈说加工食品对我们不好。

examples.sentence: We should eat less processed foods and more fresh vegetables.
examples.trans: 我们应该少吃加工食品，多吃新鲜蔬菜。

examples.sentence: If you eat too many processed foods, you may put on weight quickly.
examples.trans: 如果你吃太多加工食品，你可能会很快长胖。

examples.sentence: Replacing processed foods with home-cooked meals can significantly improve your overall health.
examples.trans: 用家常饭菜代替加工食品可以显著改善你的整体健康状况。

examples.sentence: Unlike whole grains and fresh produce, processed foods often contain hidden amounts of salt and sugar that make them hard to resist.
examples.trans: 与全谷物和新鲜农产品不同，加工食品往往含有隐藏的盐和糖，让人难以抗拒。

examples.sentence: A growing body of research indicates that a diet dominated by processed foods is closely linked to an increased risk of chronic diseases such as diabetes and heart disease.
examples.trans: 越来越多的研究表明，以加工食品为主的饮食与糖尿病、心脏病等慢性疾病风险的增加密切相关。

take part in.usageZh: 动词短语，不可拆分，后接名词、动名词或表示活动的名词短语。多用于表示参加活动、比赛、讨论等，语体较正式，比 join 更强调参与过程。

examples.sentence: I want to take part in the school sports meeting.
examples.trans: 我想参加学校运动会。

examples.sentence: Our class decided to take part in the English singing competition.
examples.trans: 我们班决定参加英语歌唱比赛。

examples.sentence: If you take part in the volunteer activity, you will make many new friends.
examples.trans: 如果你参加这次志愿活动，你会交到很多新朋友。

examples.sentence: Students who take part in extracurricular activities tend to develop stronger time-management skills.
examples.trans: 参加课外活动的学生往往能培养更强的时间管理能力。

examples.sentence: Rather than simply observing, the new curriculum encourages every student to take part in designing their own experiments.
examples.trans: 新课程鼓励每个学生参与设计自己的实验，而不是仅仅旁观。

examples.sentence: The opportunity to take part in an international exchange program not only broadens one's horizons but also fosters a deeper understanding of cultural diversity.
examples.trans: 参加国际交流项目的机会不仅能拓宽视野，还能培养对文化多样性的更深理解。

check with.usageZh: 动词短语，后接表示人或机构的名词作宾语。常用结构为 check with someone before doing something，表示在做某事之前先向某人核实或咨询。语体偏口语和实用场景。

examples.sentence: I need to check with my dad before I go out.
examples.trans: 我出门前需要问一下我爸爸。

examples.sentence: You should check with the teacher about the test date.
examples.trans: 你应该向老师确认考试日期。

examples.sentence: Before you buy the ticket, check with your parents if you can go.
examples.trans: 在你买票之前，先问问你父母你是否能去。

examples.sentence: It is advisable to check with your doctor before starting any new exercise routine.
examples.trans: 在开始任何新的锻炼计划之前，最好先咨询你的医生。

examples.sentence: Before submitting the final draft, she checked with her supervisor to ensure that every detail met the academic requirements.
examples.trans: 在提交终稿之前，她与导师核实，确保每个细节都符合学术要求。

examples.sentence: Given the complexity of the regulations, companies are strongly advised to check with legal experts before launching any cross-border marketing campaign.
examples.trans: 鉴于法规的复杂性，强烈建议公司在开展任何跨境营销活动之前先咨询法律专家。

pay attention to.usageZh: 动词短语，后接名词、代词或名词性从句作宾语。常用结构：'pay (more/close) attention to something/someone'。口语和书面语均常见，to 为介词，后接动词时用动名词形式。

examples.sentence: Please pay attention to the teacher in class.
examples.trans: 上课时请注意听老师讲。

examples.sentence: You should pay attention to the traffic lights when you cross the road.
examples.trans: 过马路时你应该注意红绿灯。

examples.sentence: If you pay close attention to the instructions, you won't make that mistake again.
examples.trans: 如果你仔细留意说明，就不会再犯那个错误了。

examples.sentence: Having realized the importance of body signals, more athletes are paying attention to how their muscles respond during training.
examples.trans: 意识到身体信号的重要性后，越来越多的运动员开始关注训练中肌肉的反应。

examples.sentence: Rather than focusing on speed alone, experienced drivers pay particular attention to road conditions ahead.
examples.trans: 有经验的司机不会只关注速度，而是特别注意前方的路况。

examples.sentence: Researchers emphasize that paying sustained attention to sleep quality yields long-term benefits that no supplement can replicate.
examples.trans: 研究人员强调，持续关注睡眠质量所带来的长期益处是任何补剂都无法复制的。

play a role in.usageZh: 动词短语，后接名词、动名词或名词短语。常用结构：'play an important/a key/a vital role in (doing) something'。可用于描述人或事物在某过程、事件或结果中的贡献或影响。

examples.sentence: My mom plays an important role in my life.
examples.trans: 妈妈在我的生活中扮演着重要的角色。

examples.sentence: Eating vegetables plays a big role in keeping us healthy.
examples.trans: 吃蔬菜对保持健康有很大作用。

examples.sentence: Good habits play a key role in improving your grades at school.
examples.trans: 良好的习惯对提高学习成绩起着关键作用。

examples.sentence: Regular exercise plays a vital role in reducing the risk of heart disease among office workers.
examples.trans: 规律运动在降低上班族心脏病风险方面起着至关重要的作用。

examples.sentence: While talent matters, consistent practice plays a far greater role in mastering a foreign language.
examples.trans: 天赋固然重要，但持续练习在掌握一门外语中所起的作用要大得多。

examples.sentence: The study reveals that parental involvement plays a decisive role in shaping a child's attitude toward lifelong learning.
examples.trans: 研究表明，父母的参与在塑造孩子终身学习态度方面起着决定性作用。

defend against.usageZh: 动词短语，后接表示威胁、攻击、疾病等的名词作宾语。常用于描述身体免疫、军事防御或抽象层面的抵御。语体偏正式，书面语中常见。

examples.sentence: Wear a hat to defend against the sun.
examples.trans: 戴顶帽子来防晒。

examples.sentence: Washing your hands often helps defend against germs.
examples.trans: 勤洗手有助于抵御细菌。

examples.sentence: A healthy diet can help your body defend against colds and flu.
examples.trans: 健康的饮食能帮助身体抵御感冒和流感。

examples.sentence: The immune system produces antibodies to defend against harmful bacteria entering the bloodstream.
examples.trans: 免疫系统产生抗体来抵御进入血液的有害细菌。

examples.sentence: Unlike passive treatments, building up your natural immunity defends against recurring infections more effectively.
examples.trans: 与被动的治疗不同，增强自身免疫力能更有效地抵御反复感染。

examples.sentence: Public health policies aimed at improving sanitation have proven essential in defending communities against the spread of infectious diseases.
examples.trans: 旨在改善卫生条件的公共卫生政策已被证明对保护社区免受传染病传播至关重要。

wash away.usageZh: 动词短语，可分开使用，如 "wash the dirt away"。后接名词表示被洗掉或冲走的东西。既可用于日常清洗，也可用于比喻（如冲走记忆、罪恶等）。

examples.sentence: Rain can wash away the chalk on the ground.
examples.trans: 雨水能把地上的粉笔冲掉。

examples.sentence: She used warm water to wash away the mud on her shoes.
examples.trans: 她用温水冲掉了鞋子上的泥。

examples.sentence: The waves slowly washed away the words we wrote in the sand.
examples.trans: 海浪慢慢冲掉了我们写在沙子上的字。

examples.sentence: Nothing can wash away the guilt he feels for lying to his best friend.
examples.trans: 没有什么能洗去他因对最好的朋友撒谎而产生的内疚。

examples.sentence: Heavy rain over the weekend washed away the topsoil, leaving the field almost useless for planting.
examples.trans: 周末的暴雨冲走了表土，使这块地几乎无法再种植。

examples.sentence: Time does not automatically wash away the consequences of one's choices, however much one may wish it would.
examples.trans: 时间并不会自动冲走一个人选择的后果，无论他多么希望如此。

blow your nose.usageZh: 动词短语，通常用作祈使句或陈述句。主语为人，表示清理鼻腔的动作。可加副词修饰，如 gently、quietly。口语和书面语均常见。

examples.sentence: Take a tissue and blow your nose, please.
examples.trans: 请拿张纸巾擤一下鼻涕。

examples.sentence: My little brother doesn't know how to blow his nose by himself yet.
examples.trans: 我弟弟还不会自己擤鼻涕。

examples.sentence: If you blow your nose too hard, your ears may start to hurt.
examples.trans: 如果你擤鼻涕太用力，耳朵可能会开始疼。

examples.sentence: The doctor advised him to blow his nose gently to avoid damaging the small blood vessels inside.
examples.trans: 医生建议他轻轻擤鼻涕，以免损伤里面的小血管。

examples.sentence: During the allergy season, he finds himself blowing his nose constantly throughout the day.
examples.trans: 在过敏季节，他发现自己一整天都在不停地擤鼻涕。

examples.sentence: Blowing your nose into a tissue and disposing of it properly is one of the simplest yet most effective ways to prevent the spread of infection.
examples.trans: 把鼻涕擤到纸巾里并妥善处理，是防止感染传播最简单却最有效的方法之一。

prepare food.usageZh: 动词短语，后接名词或用于不定式。可指洗、切、烹饪等整个备餐过程。常与 safely、properly、for someone 等搭配使用。

examples.sentence: My mom and I prepare food together every evening.
examples.trans: 我妈妈和我每天晚上一起准备食物。

examples.sentence: Wash your hands before you prepare food for other people.
examples.trans: 在给别人准备食物之前要先洗手。

examples.sentence: The school kitchen staff prepare food for more than five hundred students every day.
examples.trans: 学校厨房的工作人员每天为五百多名学生准备食物。

examples.sentence: Knowing how to prepare food properly is a basic life skill that every teenager should learn before leaving home.
examples.trans: 知道如何正确准备食物是每个青少年离家前都应该学会的基本生活技能。

examples.sentence: Unlike his roommate, who lives on instant noodles, David takes real pleasure in preparing food from fresh ingredients.
examples.trans: 与靠方便面度日的室友不同，大卫真正享受用新鲜食材做饭的乐趣。

examples.sentence: Restaurants are legally required to ensure that anyone who prepares food for customers has received adequate training in hygiene and food safety.
examples.trans: 法律要求餐馆确保任何为顾客准备食物的人都接受过充分的卫生和食品安全培训。

on average.usageZh: 介词短语，作状语，常置于句首或句中，用于表达统计意义上的平均水平或一般情况。可修饰动词、形容词或整个句子。口语和书面语均常用。

examples.sentence: On average, I drink three cups of water a day.
examples.trans: 我平均每天喝三杯水。

examples.sentence: On average, my father spends forty minutes driving to work every morning.
examples.trans: 我爸爸平均每天早上花四十分钟开车上班。

examples.sentence: On average, a person blinks about fifteen times every minute without noticing it.
examples.trans: 平均来说，一个人每分钟会无意识地眨眼大约十五次。

examples.sentence: On average, teenagers who eat breakfast regularly tend to concentrate better in morning classes.
examples.trans: 平均而言，经常吃早餐的青少年在上午的课堂上往往注意力更集中。

examples.sentence: On average, households in this region consume considerably less electricity in summer than those in the south.
examples.trans: 平均来看，该地区家庭夏季用电量远低于南方家庭。

examples.sentence: On average, employees who take short breaks during long shifts report higher levels of both productivity and job satisfaction.
examples.trans: 平均而言，在长时间轮班中短暂休息的员工报告的生产力和工作满意度都更高。

running water.usageZh: 名词短语，不可数，指从水龙头或水源持续流出的水。常与 access to、clean、hot/cold 等搭配。在卫生、生活条件话题中高频出现。

examples.sentence: Wash the apples under running water before you eat them.
examples.trans: 吃苹果之前先用流动的水冲洗一下。

examples.sentence: The kitchen tap was broken, so we had no running water for the whole afternoon.
examples.trans: 厨房的水龙头坏了，所以我们整个下午都没有自来水。

examples.sentence: Doctors advise people to wash a cut with clean running water before putting on a bandage.
examples.trans: 医生建议人们先用干净的流动水冲洗伤口，再贴上创可贴。

examples.sentence: Having access to clean running water is something many city residents take for granted.
examples.trans: 能用到干净的流动水是许多城市居民习以为常的事。

examples.sentence: Unlike still water, running water is less likely to become a breeding ground for mosquitoes.
examples.trans: 与死水不同，流动的水不太可能成为蚊子滋生的温床。

examples.sentence: The lack of reliable running water in remote communities remains a major barrier to improving public health.
examples.trans: 偏远社区缺乏稳定的流动水源，这仍然是改善公共卫生的一大障碍。

dry your hands.usageZh: 动词短语，常用于祈使句或表示建议的语境中。可搭配 thoroughly、completely、with a towel 等。在卫生、餐饮、医疗场景中高频出现。

examples.sentence: Dry your hands with this clean towel, please.
examples.trans: 请用这条干净的毛巾擦干手。

examples.sentence: If you don't dry your hands well, the cold wind will make them feel even colder.
examples.trans: 如果你不把手擦干，冷风会让手感觉更冷。

examples.sentence: After washing the dishes, my mother always dries her hands before touching the phone.
examples.trans: 洗完碗后，我妈妈总是先擦干手再碰手机。

examples.sentence: Make sure you dry your hands completely before handling electrical equipment.
examples.trans: 接触电器设备之前，一定要把手完全擦干。

examples.sentence: Research suggests that failing to dry your hands properly can spread more bacteria than not washing them at all.
examples.trans: 研究表明，洗手后没有彻底擦干手所传播的细菌可能比完全不洗手还要多。

examples.sentence: In food processing plants, workers are required to dry their hands with disposable paper towels rather than shared cloth ones.
examples.trans: 在食品加工厂，工人被要求用一次性纸巾而不是共用布巾擦干手。

at hand.usageZh: 介词短语，通常用作表语或后置定语。表示空间上的接近或时间上的临近。常见搭配：have sth at hand（手头有某物）、the task at hand（手头的任务）、help is at hand（援助近在咫尺）。

examples.sentence: I always keep a pencil at hand when I do my homework.
examples.trans: 我做作业时总是在手边放一支铅笔。

examples.sentence: She keeps her phone at hand so she can answer calls quickly.
examples.trans: 她把手机放在手边，这样就能快速接电话。

examples.sentence: With the final exam at hand, every minute of study time counts.
examples.trans: 期末考试临近，每一分钟的学习时间都很宝贵。

examples.sentence: Having a first-aid kit at hand is essential when you go camping in remote areas.
examples.trans: 在偏远地区露营时，手边备一个急救箱是必不可少的。

examples.sentence: Rather than searching for solutions online, she prefers to have a dictionary at hand while translating.
examples.trans: 与其在网上搜索答案，她更愿意在翻译时手边放一本词典。

examples.sentence: The committee emphasized that, with the deadline at hand, all departments must submit their reports without further delay.
examples.trans: 委员会强调，截止日期迫在眉睫，所有部门必须立即提交报告，不得再拖延。

wash your hands.usageZh: 动词短语，通常用作祈使句或陈述句。常见搭配：wash your hands before eating（饭前洗手）、wash your hands with soap（用肥皂洗手）。也可用于比喻义，如 wash your hands of sth（洗手不干；对某事不再负责）。

examples.sentence: Wash your hands before you eat the bread.
examples.trans: 吃面包之前先洗手。

examples.sentence: Remember to wash your hands with soap after playing outside.
examples.trans: 在外面玩完后记得用肥皂洗手。

examples.sentence: Doctors always wash their hands carefully before they examine a patient.
examples.trans: 医生在检查病人之前总是仔细洗手。

examples.sentence: Having touched the raw meat, you should wash your hands thoroughly to avoid cross-contamination.
examples.trans: 碰过生肉之后，你应该彻底洗手，以避免交叉污染。

examples.sentence: The sign in the restaurant kitchen reads: "Employees must wash their hands before returning to work."
examples.trans: 餐厅厨房里的标牌写着：“员工返回工作岗位前必须洗手。”

examples.sentence: Public health campaigns consistently stress that one of the simplest yet most effective ways to prevent infection is to wash your hands regularly with soap and running water.
examples.trans: 公共卫生宣传一贯强调，预防感染最简单却最有效的方法之一就是用肥皂和流动的水经常洗手。

keep away from.usageZh: 动词短语，后接名词、代词或动名词。表示“远离某人/某物”或“避免接触某物”。常见搭配：keep away from danger（远离危险）、keep away from junk food（远离垃圾食品）、keep children away from the fire（让孩子远离火源）。

examples.sentence: Keep away from the hot stove, or you will get hurt.
examples.trans: 离热炉子远一点，否则你会受伤的。

examples.sentence: My mother told me to keep away from that old bridge because it is not safe.
examples.trans: 妈妈告诉我远离那座旧桥，因为它不安全。

examples.sentence: If you want to stay healthy, you should keep away from sugary drinks and eat more fruit.
examples.trans: 如果你想保持健康，就应该远离含糖饮料，多吃水果。

examples.sentence: The police warned the public to keep away from the area while the fire was being put out.
examples.trans: 警方警告公众在灭火期间远离该区域。

examples.sentence: To maintain a balanced diet, nutritionists advise people to keep away from highly processed foods whenever possible.
examples.trans: 为了保持均衡饮食，营养学家建议人们尽可能远离高度加工的食品。

examples.sentence: The safety guidelines explicitly state that all personnel must keep away from the loading dock during heavy machinery operation, as even a momentary lapse in attention could prove fatal.
examples.trans: 安全指南明确规定，重型机械作业期间所有人员必须远离装卸区，因为哪怕一瞬间的疏忽都可能致命。

animal waste.usageZh: 名词短语，通常作宾语或主语。常与 clean up, dispose of, remove, collect 等动词搭配。多用于环保、公共卫生、农业等语境，语体偏正式。

examples.sentence: Don't touch animal waste with your hands.
examples.trans: 不要用手碰动物粪便。

examples.sentence: We should clean up animal waste in the park to keep it clean.
examples.trans: 我们应该清理公园里的动物粪便，保持公园干净。

examples.sentence: Farmers often use animal waste to make the soil richer for growing crops.
examples.trans: 农民经常用动物粪便让土壤更肥沃，以便种植庄稼。

examples.sentence: If animal waste is not disposed of properly, it can pollute nearby rivers and lakes.
examples.trans: 如果动物粪便没有被妥善处理，它可能会污染附近的河流和湖泊。

examples.sentence: Unlike chemical fertilizers, animal waste improves soil structure while releasing nutrients slowly.
examples.trans: 与化肥不同，动物粪便在缓慢释放养分的同时还能改善土壤结构。

examples.sentence: The improper handling of animal waste on large farms has become a major concern for both environmental agencies and local communities.
examples.trans: 大型农场对动物粪便的不当处理已成为环保机构和当地社区共同关注的重要问题。

at least.usageZh: 介词短语，作状语，修饰数量、程度或频率。常放在数词或数量短语前，表示最低限度。口语和书面语都常用，语气较为肯定。

examples.sentence: I drink at least three cups of water every day.
examples.trans: 我每天至少喝三杯水。

examples.sentence: You should sleep at least eight hours before the exam.
examples.trans: 考试前你应该至少睡八个小时。

examples.sentence: The museum is very popular, so you need to book tickets at least one week in advance.
examples.trans: 这个博物馆很受欢迎，所以你至少需要提前一周订票。

examples.sentence: To stay healthy, doctors recommend that teenagers get at least one hour of physical activity each day.
examples.trans: 为了保持健康，医生建议青少年每天至少进行一小时的体育活动。

examples.sentence: At least half of the participants in the survey said they preferred online learning to traditional classroom instruction.
examples.trans: 调查中至少有一半的参与者表示，比起传统课堂教学，他们更喜欢在线学习。

examples.sentence: Even if the project cannot be completed on schedule, we should at least ensure that every stage meets the required safety standards.
examples.trans: 即使项目无法按期完成，我们至少也应确保每个阶段都符合规定的安全标准。

grammar.key: Not only... but also... / 不仅...而且...
grammar.title: Not only... but also... 不仅……而且……（含倒装、主谓一致与近义结构拓展）
grammar.titleEn: Not only... but also...: Correlative Conjunction for Emphasis and Progression
grammar.usage:
“Not only... but also...” 是英语中表示递进关系的并列连词结构，意为“不仅……而且……”，用于连接两个在语法功能上相同的成分，如主语、谓语、宾语、表语、状语或整个句子。其核心作用是突出后者，使语气比单独使用 and 或 also 更强烈。

在肯定句中，该结构直接连接两个并列成分；在否定或疑问句中，通常将 not only 部分置于助动词、情态动词或 be 动词之后，而 but also 部分保持正常语序。例如：He didn't not only come late but also forgot his book. 这种用法在高中阶段更强调语序和助动词的准确位置。

与近义结构相比，“not only... but also...” 比 “both... and...” 更强调递进和出乎意料，而 “both... and...” 只表示并列；“not only... but also...” 与 “as well as” 的区别在于前者强调后者，后者强调前者。例如：She is not only a teacher but also a writer.（强调 writer）与 She is a writer as well as a teacher.（强调 teacher）。

初中阶段主要要求掌握该结构连接两个主语或谓语时的基本用法，以及连接主语时谓语动词与 but also 后的主语保持一致。高中阶段则进一步要求掌握 not only 置于句首时的部分倒装、与情态动词和完成时态的搭配、在书面语和正式文体中的使用，以及避免与 but 或 also 重复使用等语域问题。

易错点一：当 not only 位于句首且连接两个分句时，not only 所在的分句需要部分倒装，但 but also 后的分句不倒装。易错点二：连接两个主语时，谓语动词的数与 but also 后的主语保持一致，而非与 not only 后的主语一致。易错点三：but also 中的 also 有时可以省略，但在正式书面语中保留 also 更常见；如果 but also 后接的是代词，需注意代词格的一致性。易错点四：不要将 not only... but also... 与 not... but... 混淆，前者表示“不仅……而且……”，后者表示“不是……而是……”。
forms: Not only + 成分A + but also + 成分B（连接两个并列成分）
Not only + 助动词/be/情态动词 + 主语 + 谓语 + but also + 主语 + 谓语（句首倒装）
Not only + 主语1 + but also + 主语2 + 谓语动词（谓语与主语2保持一致）
主语 + not only + 谓语1 + but also + 谓语2（同一主语，连接两个谓语，不倒装）
Not only + 介词短语/副词 + but also + 介词短语/副词（连接状语）
Not only + 从句 + but also + 从句（连接两个从句，正式书面语）
notes: 当 not only 置于句首且连接两个分句时，not only 所在分句必须部分倒装，但 but also 后的分句保持正常语序。高考书面表达中倒装错误是常见失分点。
连接两个主语时，谓语动词的单复数取决于 but also 后的主语，即“就近原则”。例如：Not only the students but also the teacher was invited. 这在高考语法填空和短文改错中高频出现。
在正式书面语中，but also 一般不省略 also；但在口语或非正式文体中，also 有时可省略。高考写作中建议保留 also 以体现正式语域。
注意不要与 not... but...（不是……而是……）混淆。前者表示递进，后者表示转折或对比。例如：He is not a doctor but a nurse.（他不是医生，而是护士。）
当 not only... but also... 连接两个谓语动词时，如果主语相同，则不需要倒装，但要注意两个谓语在时态、语态和情态动词上的一致性。

examples.en: She not only sings well but also plays the piano beautifully.
examples.cn: 她不仅歌唱得好，而且钢琴也弹得很美。

examples.en: Not only did he finish the project on time, but he also helped his teammates.
examples.cn: 他不仅按时完成了项目，而且还帮助了队友。

examples.en: Not only the students but also the teacher was surprised by the result.
examples.cn: 不仅学生们，而且老师也对结果感到惊讶。

examples.en: The new policy not only reduces costs but also improves efficiency.
examples.cn: 新政策不仅降低了成本，而且提高了效率。

examples.en: Not only has she published several novels, but she has also won a national literary award.
examples.cn: 她不仅出版了几部小说，而且还获得了国家文学奖。

examples.en: Not only is the proposed solution economically viable, but it is also environmentally sustainable.
examples.cn: 所提出的解决方案不仅在经济上可行，而且在环境上也是可持续的。

exercises.q: My sister ______ sings well ______ dances beautifully.
exercises.explain: 考查 not only...but also... 连接两个并列谓语，表示“不仅……而且……”。

exercises.q: He is not only my teacher ______ also my good friend.
exercises.explain: 固定搭配 not only...but also...，此处缺少 but。

exercises.q: Not only my father but also my mother are teachers.
exercises.explain: not only...but also... 连接主语时，谓语应与 but also 后的主语 my mother 一致，应用 is。

exercises.q: He likes apples. He likes bananas too. (用 not only...but also... 合并)
exercises.answer: He likes not only apples but also bananas.
exercises.explain: 用 not only...but also... 连接两个并列宾语，表示“不仅喜欢苹果而且喜欢香蕉”。

exercises.q: Not only he but also I is good at English.
exercises.answer: Not only he but also I am good at English.
exercises.explain: not only...but also... 连接主语时，谓语与 but also 后的主语 I 保持一致，应用 am。

exercises.q: Not only Tom but also his parents ______ going to the park this Sunday.
exercises.explain: not only...but also... 连接两个主语时，谓语动词与 but also 后的主语保持一致。

exercises.q: She can ______ play the piano ______ play the guitar.
exercises.explain: 考查 not only...but also... 连接两个并列的动词原形，表示递进关系。

exercises.q: The little boy is ______ clever ______ hard-working.
exercises.explain: not only...but also... 连接两个并列形容词，强调两者都具备。

exercises.q: ______ you ______ your brother likes watching cartoons.
exercises.explain: not only...but also... 连接两个主语，强调两人都喜欢看动画片。

exercises.q: Not only Lily but also Lucy ______ (like) reading storybooks.
exercises.explain: not only...but also... 连接主语时，谓语与 but also 后的主语 Lucy 保持一致，用第三人称单数。

exercises.q: The food in this restaurant is not only cheap ______ delicious.
exercises.explain: not only...but also... 连接两个并列形容词，表示“不仅便宜而且美味”。

exercises.q: She not only sings well but also dances well.
exercises.explain: not only...but also... 连接两个并列谓语，结构正确。

exercises.q: The movie is interesting. The movie is exciting. (用 not only...but also... 合并)
exercises.answer: The movie is not only interesting but also exciting.
exercises.explain: 用 not only...but also... 连接两个并列形容词作表语。

exercises.q: My brother can swim. My brother can skate. (用 not only...but also... 合并)
exercises.answer: My brother can not only swim but also skate.
exercises.explain: not only...but also... 连接两个并列动词原形，情态动词 can 后接动词原形。

exercises.q: She not only likes reading but also write stories.
exercises.answer: She not only likes reading but also writes stories.
exercises.explain: not only...but also... 连接并列谓语，前后时态和形式应保持一致，write 应改为 writes。

exercises.q: Not only ______ good at math, but he also does well in physics.
exercises.explain: Not only 置于句首时，其后的主句需要部分倒装，be 动词提前。

exercises.q: Not only ______ (do) he like playing basketball, but he also enjoys swimming.
exercises.explain: Not only 置于句首引起部分倒装，主语 he 为第三人称单数，用 does 构成倒装。

exercises.q: Not only does he speak English well, but he also writes it perfectly.
exercises.explain: Not only 置于句首引起部分倒装，does 提前，结构正确。

exercises.q: He can speak French. He can also speak German. (用 not only...but also... 合并)
exercises.answer: He can speak not only French but also German.
exercises.explain: 用 not only...but also... 连接两个并列宾语，表示“不仅会说法语而且会说德语”。

exercises.q: Not only he can sing, but he can also dance.
exercises.answer: Not only can he sing, but he can also dance.
exercises.explain: Not only 置于句首时，其后的主句需要部分倒装，can 应提前到主语 he 之前。

exercises.q: The trip was not only educational ______ also very enjoyable.
exercises.explain: 固定搭配 not only...but also...，此处缺少 but。

exercises.q: Not only the students but also the teacher ______ interested in the new project.
exercises.explain: not only...but also... 连接主语时，谓语与 but also 后的主语 the teacher 保持一致，用单数。

exercises.q: He ______ plays the violin ______ composes music for his school band.
exercises.explain: not only...but also... 连接两个并列谓语，表示“不仅拉小提琴而且作曲”。

exercises.q: Not only ______ the book interesting, but it also teaches us a lot about history.
exercises.explain: Not only 置于句首引起倒装，主语 the book 是单数，用 is。

exercises.q: The young man is not only a talented singer ______ also a great dancer.
exercises.explain: 固定搭配 not only...but also...，连接两个并列名词短语。

exercises.q: Not only my classmates but also my best friend ______ (be) going to attend the party.
exercises.explain: not only...but also... 连接主语时，谓语与 but also 后的主语 my best friend 保持一致，用单数。

exercises.q: Not only the manager but also the workers was satisfied with the result.
exercises.explain: not only...but also... 连接主语时，谓语应与 but also 后的主语 the workers 一致，应用 were。

exercises.q: The story is interesting. The story is educational. (用 not only...but also... 合并)
exercises.answer: The story is not only interesting but also educational.
exercises.explain: 用 not only...but also... 连接两个并列形容词作表语。

exercises.q: She likes reading novels. She likes writing poems. (用 not only...but also... 合并)
exercises.answer: She likes not only reading novels but also writing poems.
exercises.explain: 用 not only...but also... 连接两个并列动名词短语作宾语。

exercises.q: The film not only was boring but also too long.
exercises.answer: The film was not only boring but also too long.
exercises.explain: not only...but also... 连接并列形容词时，应放在 be 动词之后。

exercises.q: Not only ______ the exam difficult, but it also covered a wide range of topics.
exercises.explain: Not only 置于句首引起倒装，主语 the exam 是单数，结合语境用一般过去时 was。

exercises.q: Not only ______ (be) the concert amazing, but it also raised money for charity.
exercises.explain: Not only 置于句首引起倒装，主语 the concert 是单数，结合语境用一般过去时 was。

exercises.q: Not only has she won several awards, but she has also inspired many young artists.
exercises.explain: Not only 置于句首引起部分倒装，has 提前，结构正确。

exercises.q: The new app saves time. It also reduces costs. (用 not only...but also... 合并)
exercises.answer: The new app not only saves time but also reduces costs.
exercises.explain: 用 not only...but also... 连接两个并列谓语，表示“不仅节省时间而且降低成本”。

exercises.q: Not only the manager but also the employees was unhappy with the new schedule.
exercises.answer: Not only the manager but also the employees were unhappy with the new schedule.
exercises.explain: not only...but also... 连接主语时，谓语应与 but also 后的主语 the employees 一致，应用 were。

exercises.q: The new policy not only benefits the economy ______ creates more job opportunities.
exercises.explain: 固定搭配 not only...but also...，连接两个并列谓语，表示递进关系。

exercises.q: Not only the children but also their mother ______ fond of the new cartoon series.
exercises.explain: not only...but also... 连接主语时，谓语与 but also 后的主语 their mother 保持一致，用单数。

exercises.q: ______ did he finish the project on time, ______ he also exceeded all expectations.
exercises.explain: Not only 置于句首引起倒装，与 but also 搭配，此处 also 可省略。

exercises.q: The scientist is respected not only for his discoveries ______ for his dedication to teaching.
exercises.explain: not only...but also... 连接两个并列的介词短语，表示“不仅因为……而且因为……”。

exercises.q: The novel not only tells an exciting story ______ also explores deep social issues.
exercises.explain: 固定搭配 not only...but also...，连接两个并列谓语，此处缺少 but。

exercises.q: Not only the teacher but also the students ______ (have) been invited to the ceremony.
exercises.explain: not only...but also... 连接主语时，谓语与 but also 后的主语 the students 保持一致，用复数。

exercises.q: Not only the design but also the materials used in the building was carefully chosen.
exercises.explain: not only...but also... 连接主语时，谓语应与 but also 后的主语 the materials 一致，应用 were。

exercises.q: He is a talented musician. He is also a successful businessman. (用 not only...but also... 合并)
exercises.answer: He is not only a talented musician but also a successful businessman.
exercises.explain: 用 not only...but also... 连接两个并列名词短语作表语。

exercises.q: The project requires careful planning. It also demands teamwork. (用 not only...but also... 合并)
exercises.answer: The project not only requires careful planning but also demands teamwork.
exercises.explain: 用 not only...but also... 连接两个并列谓语，表示“不仅需要……而且要求……”。

exercises.q: Not only she speaks three languages, but she also understands different cultures.
exercises.answer: Not only does she speak three languages, but she also understands different cultures.

grammar.key: Gerund as Subject / 动名词作主语
grammar.title: 动名词作主语：从基本结构到 it 形式主语句型拓展
grammar.titleEn: Gerund as Subject: Basic Structure and It-Extraposition Patterns
grammar.usage:
动名词作主语是英语中表达“泛指概念、习惯性动作或一般性事实”的常用手段。动名词由“动词原形 + -ing”构成，在句中具有名词性质，可以单独作主语，也可以带宾语、状语等构成动名词短语作主语。核心结构为“动名词（短语）+ 单数谓语动词”，例如：Taking part in regular exercise is important. 动名词作主语时，谓语动词一律用单数形式，因为动名词短语被视为一个整体概念。

肯定句直接以动名词短语开头，如：Reading widely helps you think better. 否定形式在动名词前加 not，如：Not getting enough sleep can affect your mood. 疑问句一般不用动名词直接开头，而是借助 it 形式主语或使用一般疑问句结构，如：Is getting up early good for your health? 在书面语中，疑问句更常转化为“Is it good for your health to get up early?”。

动名词作主语与不定式作主语有重要区别。动名词作主语多表示抽象的、习惯性的、一般性的行为或已知事实；不定式作主语则常表示具体的、一次性的或将来的动作。例如：Swimming is my favourite sport.（泛指游泳这项运动）与 To swim in this cold river is dangerous.（指在特定情况下的一次具体行为）。高中阶段要求掌握“It is + adj. + (for/of sb) + to do sth.”与“Doing sth. is + adj.”之间的转换，但要注意并非所有形容词都能自由转换，某些形容词如 necessary、important、possible 更常与不定式搭配，而 useless、worthwhile、no use、no good 等则更常与动名词搭配。

初中阶段主要掌握动名词作主语时谓语动词用单数，以及“Doing sth. is + adj.”的基本表达。高中阶段则进一步要求：第一，能识别并正确使用动名词短语作主语的长句；第二，能区分动名词与不定式作主语的语用差异；第三，能运用 it 作形式主语的句型进行书面语升级；第四，掌握“There is no + 动名词”等固定句型；第五，在写作中避免动名词作主语时常见的逻辑主语不一致问题。

易错点一：动名词作主语时，谓语动词容易受动名词短语中名词复数的影响而误用复数。例如“Reading books are interesting”是错误的，应改为“Reading books is interesting”。易错点二：把动名词作主语与现在分词作定语或状语混淆。例如“Running water is clean”中 running 是现在分词作定语，不是动名词作主语。易错点三：在“It is + adj. + to do”句型中，部分学生误把 it 当作动名词的替代词，实际上 it 只能替代不定式或 that 从句，不能替代动名词。易错点四：动名词的否定形式 not 位置容易放错，应放在动名词之前，而不是谓语动词之前。
forms: 动名词（短语）+ 单数谓语动词：Doing sth. + V-s/es + ...
否定形式：Not + doing sth. + V-s/es + ...
it 形式主语句型：It is + adj. + (for/of sb) + to do sth. ≈ Doing sth. is + adj.
固定句型：There is no + doing sth.（表示“不可能……”）
动名词复合结构作主语：One's + doing sth. + V-s/es + ...（书面语）
疑问句形式：Is + doing sth. + adj./noun? 或 Is it + adj. + to do sth.?
notes: 动名词短语作主语时，无论短语内部有多少复数名词，谓语动词一律用单数。高考短文改错和语法填空中常考此点。
书面语中，动名词复合结构“One's doing sth.”作主语时，物主代词不可用宾格代替，如“His coming late made the teacher angry”不可写成“Him coming late...”。
“There is no + 动名词”是高中固定句型，表示“不可能做某事”，如“There is no denying that...”在高考写作中属于高级表达。
动名词作主语与不定式作主语的语域差异：动名词更正式、更抽象，适合议论文和说明文；不定式更具体，适合叙述具体事件。高考书面表达中应根据语境选择。
注意区分动名词作主语与现在分词作定语：动名词作主语时位于句首且后面紧跟谓语动词；现在分词作定语时紧跟名词，如“the running water”中的 running 不是主语。

grammar.key: Modal Verb 'can' for Ability/Possibility / 情态动词'can'表能力/可能性
grammar.title: 情态动词 can 表能力与可能性（含 could / be able to / may / might 拓展）
grammar.titleEn: Modal Verb 'can' for Ability and Possibility (with could / be able to / may / might)
grammar.usage:
情态动词 can 在高中阶段主要承担两种核心语义：一是表示“能力”，即主语具备完成某事的条件或技能；二是表示“可能性”，即说话人认为某事在客观条件下可能发生。其核心结构为“can + 动词原形”，无人称和数的变化。肯定句如：Water can help maintain blood pressure. 否定句在 can 后加 not，写作 cannot 或 can't。一般疑问句将 can 提前，如：Can every part of your body function without water? 回答用 Yes, it can. / No, it can't.

在能力义上，can 与 be able to 常可互换，但 be able to 可用于各种时态，而 can 只有现在式和过去式 could。高中阶段需注意：表示过去某次具体做成某事时，更常用 was/were able to 或 managed to，而不是 could。例如：He was able to finish the experiment on time. 若用 could 则多表示过去的一般能力或可能性。

在可能性义上，can 多用于肯定句表示“理论上的可能”或“有时会”，而 may / might 表示“事实上的可能”且语气更弱、更不确定。例如：Drinking too little water can cause headaches.（理论上可能）It may rain this afternoon.（事实上可能）在疑问句和否定句中，can 表可能性时意为“难道会/不可能”，如：Can it be true? It can't be true.

初中阶段主要要求掌握 can 表能力和许可的基本用法，以及 can't 表禁止。高中阶段则进一步要求区分 can / could / be able to / may / might 在语域、时态和确定性上的差异，并在书面表达中根据语境准确选用。

易错点一：情态动词后接动词原形，不可接 to do 或 doing。易错点二：can 的否定形式在书面语中常写作 cannot，而非 can not（分开写仅在强调 not 时出现）。易错点三：could 表过去能力时，不可用于表示过去某次具体做成某事，此时应用 was/were able to。易错点四：may 表可能性时一般不用于疑问句，疑问句中表可能性多用 can 或 might。
forms: 肯定：主语 + can + 动词原形
否定：主语 + cannot / can't + 动词原形
疑问：Can + 主语 + 动词原形 + ...?
过去能力：主语 + could + 动词原形（一般能力）
过去具体做成：主语 + was/were able to + 动词原形
可能性对比：can（理论可能）/ may, might（事实可能，语气递减）
notes: 高考书面语中，cannot 通常写成一个词，can not 分开写仅在强调否定时出现。
could 表示过去一般能力，不表示过去某次具体做成某事；后者用 was/were able to 或 managed to。
can 表可能性时多用于肯定句和否定句，may 表可能性时不用于疑问句，疑问句中用 can 或 might。
be able to 可用于完成时和将来时，can 不能；如 have been able to、will be able to。
在正式语域中，表许可时 may 比 can 更正式，can 偏口语化。

exercises.explain: can not 表示可能性，意为“可能不”。

exercises.explain: 一般疑问句将 can 提前，后接主语和动词原形。

exercises.q: He can play basketball. (改为一般疑问句)
exercises.explain: 一般疑问句将 can 提到主语前。

exercises.q: She is able to cook dinner. (用 can 改写)
exercises.explain: be able to 表示能力，可替换为 can。

exercises.q: Do you can swim?

exercises.explain: should 表示建议，意为“应该”。

exercises.q: You ______ finish your homework before you watch TV.

exercises.explain: mustn't 后直接接动词原形，不能加 to。

exercises.explain: must 的否定形式是 mustn't，表示“不准”。

exercises.q: He must goes to the doctor because he is ill.
exercises.answer: He must go to the doctor because he is ill.
exercises.explain: 情态动词 must 后接动词原形，不能用 goes。

exercises.explain: May I...? 表示礼貌地请求许可。

exercises.q: The water in this river is not clean. You ______ drink it.
exercises.explain: mustn't 表示禁止，意为“不准、不许”。

exercises.q: When I was young, I ______ run very fast.
exercises.explain: could 表示过去的能力。

exercises.explain: may 表示不确定的推测，意为“可能”。

exercises.explain: Could you please...? 是更礼貌的请求方式。

exercises.explain: must 表示规则要求，意为“必须”。

exercises.explain: May I...? 是礼貌地请求许可的表达。

exercises.q: She ______ have arrived by now, but I haven't seen her yet.
exercises.explain: may have done 表示对过去情况的不确定推测。

exercises.explain: can't have done 表示对过去情况的否定推测，意为“不可能”。

exercises.q: I can ride a bike. (改为否定句)

exercises.answer: He can play basketball very well.

exercises.q: He was able to solve the problem by himself. (用 could 改写，保持句意不变)

exercises.explain: 表示过去的能力时 be able to 可与 could 互换。

exercises.q: She must to finish her homework before going out.
